statement: Identical MOP token identities will recur in the broad boundary role across the six Panel-3 genomes above a fixed-GC-count × wildcard-separation conditioned null.
support_condition: Observed above frozen null mean and one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo p<=0.05; strong support p<=0.01.
weakening_condition: Observed above null mean but p>0.05.
special_gate: LC-PRED-0035 only: >=50% boundary-membership movability or BLOCKED_LOW_MOVABILITY.
contamination_boundary: Species/accessions, representation, role, conditioning, statistic, threshold and seed frozen before Panel-3 sequence acquisition.
